task.title: BrowserOS - LLM-Powered Browser Agent Platform
task.description: Build a modular, event-driven browser operating system where LLM acts only as the brain and never directly controls the browser. The system uses specialized modules coordinated through an event-driven architecture.

decisions.decision: Multi-crate workspace (11 crates)
decisions.reason: Compile-time boundary enforcement for a system that will grow to 15+ subsystems

decisions.decision: Event Bus != Scheduler
decisions.reason: Routing vs timing are separate concerns with different scalability requirements

decisions.decision: Separate Plugin and Capability registries
decisions.reason: Lifecycle management is orthogonal to service discovery

decisions.decision: Canonical event hierarchy with Message Protocol
decisions.reason: Cross-subsystem tracing, correlation IDs, uniform delivery guarantees

decisions.decision: Observability as first-class crate (Logger+Metrics+Tracing)
decisions.reason: All subsystems instrumented from day one, OTLP-ready

decisions.decision: RuntimeContext replaces DI container
decisions.reason: Rust type system makes full DI speculative. RuntimeContext is simpler and sufficient.

decisions.decision: Error system merged into types crate
decisions.reason: Error types are foundational; separate crate adds unnecessary edges.

decisions.decision: Scheduler stripped to delayed + event-triggered (no cron)
decisions.reason: Cron has no use case in a reactive browser agent runtime.

decisions.decision: ModuleId moved to identifiers.rs
decisions.reason: All IDs belong in one place; message.rs getting ModuleId created hidden coupling with event.rs and module.rs.

decisions.decision: EventMetadata/MessageEnvelope timestamp parameterized (INV-004)
decisions.reason: Utc::now() baked into constructors prevented deterministic testing. Timestamp can now be injected.

decisions.decision: ModuleType is #[non_exhaustive]
decisions.reason: Future module type variants must not be breaking changes.

decisions.decision: CausationId::from_event_id() bridge added
decisions.reason: Semantic relationship between CausationId and EventId is now explicit.

decisions.decision: Config design approved — three-layer static config with isolated component configs
decisions.reason: Config trait frozen to 1 method. browseros-config provides mechanism only.

decisions.decision: Soak tests use `#[ignore]` with env var overrides (SOAK_EVENTS, SOAK_SECS)
decisions.reason: 10-30 minute tests must not run on normal cargo test.

decisions.decision: Soak tests added to browseros-stress-tests crate
decisions.reason: Reuses existing test infrastructure from Phase 1.4.1.

decisions.decision: Memory tracked via sysinfo::System process RSS
decisions.reason: Cross-platform OS-level memory query.

decisions.decision: Phase 2 uses bridge pattern — BrowserPort, SessionPort, PagePort, etc. in browseros-bridge
decisions.reason: Zero Chromium dependency at the abstraction layer.

decisions.decision: Service aggregators (BrowserService, PluginService) replace flat field expansion in RuntimeContext
decisions.reason: Prevents God object. RuntimeContext has 3 aggregate handles instead of 10+ direct fields.

decisions.decision: Synchronous browser API with async CDP transport thread
decisions.reason: Consistent with Phase 1 synchronous runtime. CDP reader thread + EventBus dispatcher decouples transport from API.

decisions.decision: LocatorStrategy is #[non_exhaustive]
decisions.reason: AI-assisted locator strategies are an active R&D area and must remain extensible.

decisions.decision: browseros-plugin uses PluginContext (not RuntimeContext)
decisions.reason: Plugins must not depend on the composition root. PluginContext is a minimal subset.

decisions.decision: Event model adds 58 domain event types
decisions.reason: Every browser state change maps to a typed event. Event kind strings form the stable agent contract.

decisions.decision: browseros-cdp AUDIT VERDICT: APPROVED WITH MINOR ISSUES
decisions.reason: 12-category audit passed. 1 Medium issue fixed (CommandTimeout mapping inconsistency). 3 Low issues deferred. 103/103 tests pass. Zero protocol type leaks verified across all 11 other crates.

decisions.decision: browseros-cdp frozen as Phase 2.4 implementation layer
decisions.reason: Audit approved. browseros-cdp is the only crate that knows CDP. All bridge traits implemented. Ready for Phase 2.5.

decisions.decision: browseros-dom architecture design completed and frozen
decisions.reason: Phase 2.5.1 design produces 6 architecture documents. All 15 categories covered. 1 Medium risk (mutation observer polling) with clear mitigation. No blocking risks. Verdict: READY FOR IMPLEMENTATION.

decisions.decision: browseros-dom public API classified into 3 tiers
decisions.reason: 25 APIs SAFE TO FREEZE, 9 KEEP FLEXIBLE, 5 EXPERIMENTAL. Safe-to-freeze APIs can be implemented immediately. Experimental APIs (AI locator, live collections, cross-frame move, in-memory CSS matching, rollback) deferred to later phases.

decisions.decision: browseros-dom has NO EventBus dependency
decisions.reason: DOM crate defines event payload types only. Upper layers wire to EventBus. Keeps DOM crate a pure leaf crate with no runtime dependencies.

decisions.decision: ElementHandle uses generation counter for stale detection
decisions.reason: AtomicU64 generation shared across clones. No auto-repair. Explicit re-acquisition via locator. Same-document re-renders do NOT invalidate handles.

decisions.decision: ElementCollection defaults to Static (not Live)
decisions.reason: Live collections with per-element backend calls have prohibitive performance. Live is opt-in. Static collections materialize all elements at creation time.

decisions.decision: browseros-llm is a NEW crate at L3
decisions.reason: Cross-cutting concern; zero dag dependency; provider-agnostic boundary enforcement

decisions.decision: MCP is an adapter, not the runtime
decisions.reason: Gateway is protocol-independent; MCP is one transport (stdio/REST) among many

decisions.decision: Streaming uses background thread + crossbeam channel
decisions.reason: Sync runtime cannot await; thread+channel is the simplest sync-compatible pattern

decisions.decision: Provider trait is single: LlProvider covers chat, stream, embed
decisions.reason: 1 trait, N adapters — adding a provider means implementing 1 trait

decisions.decision: No tokenizer or vector DB in Phase 2.1
decisions.reason: Uses provider-reported token counts; embedding store deferred to later phase

decisions.decision: Cost tracking is advisory, not hard enforcement
decisions.reason: Hard budget enforcement would break UX; alerts at thresholds instead

openQuestions: Should browseros-bridge be a separate crate from browseros-types, or should bridge types be merged into types? (Decision: separate — bridge is broader than core types)
Should browseros-cdp depend on a CDP type generation tool (e.g., pdl-to-rust) or hand-write types? (Decision: hand-write for Phase 2, generate in Phase 3)
Should ElementHandle auto-retry on stale references or fail fast? (Decision: fail fast — explicit is better than implicit)
Should plugin hooks be in Phase 2 or deferred to Phase 3? (Decision: hook definitions in Phase 2, hook runtime in Phase 3)
